summary: Amber International Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, Amber Premium FZE, received a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) License from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA). The license permits regulated virtual asset broker-dealer, management, and lending/borrowing services for institutional and qualified investors. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine operational update about regulatory licensing, not a corporate event requiring classification under any special-situation category.
